SELECT 
    f.user_registry,
    f.tier_step,
    ms.memb_days,
    la.loy_pts,
    (la.achiev_stats->>'Ach_Count')::int as ach_count,
    (la.achiev_stats->>'Ach_Count')::numeric / ms.memb_days as ad,
    la.loy_pts::numeric / f.tier_step as lpr,
    la.repute_lv
FROM fans f
JOIN membershipandspending ms ON f.user_registry = ms.member_fan_pivot
JOIN engagement e ON ms.member_reg = e.engage_member_pivot
JOIN loyaltyandachievements la ON e.engage_reg = la.loyalty_engage_pivot
WHERE (la.achiev_stats->>'Ach_Count')::numeric / ms.memb_days > 0.2
  AND la.loy_pts::numeric / f.tier_step > 500
LIMIT 10;

SELECT 
    la.repute_lv,
    COUNT(*) as top_achiever_count
FROM fans f
JOIN membershipandspending ms ON f.user_registry = ms.member_fan_pivot
JOIN engagement e ON ms.member_reg = e.engage_member_pivot
JOIN loyaltyandachievements la ON e.engage_reg = la.loyalty_engage_pivot
WHERE (la.achiev_stats->>'Ach_Count')::numeric / ms.memb_days > 0.2
  AND la.loy_pts::numeric / f.tier_step > 500
GROUP BY la.repute_lv
ORDER BY top_achiever_count DESC;
